keyFindings.text: `speckit.worktreeBase` is a local-only git-config key that was never committed (it lives in `.git/config`). The only writer in the repo is the launch wrapper, which persists the resolved base when the key is unset; the v1.5.2.0 changelog documents "Unset the config to return to the in-checkout `.worktrees` layout" as a supported operation, and no script in the tree unsets it (the doctor setup check only reports and repairs). The current config carries no `speckit.*` keys at all, so the recorded relocation to `~/worktrees/public` was lost by an unset/reset outside version control, and nothing in the repo re-establishes it. [SOURCE: .skilled/bin/worktree-session.sh:293-294] [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/sk-git/changelog/v1.5.2.0.md] [SOURCE: git config --list --show-origin | grep speckit → empty]

keyFindings.text: The 30-minute stall chain is fully traced: pre-push hook → `ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs` → `generate-leaf-manifest.cjs` `dropGitIgnoredLeaves` → `spawnSync('git', ['check-ignore', '-z', '--stdin'])` with no `timeout` option. `git check-ignore` consults the index (tracked-file check), which triggers `refresh_fsmonitor` IPC; the existing fallback at line 136 only fires on `res.error` or an exit status other than 0/1, and a hang is neither, so the push has no time ceiling. keyFindings.text: The reaper never handled git fsmonitor daemons. sk-git/026's recorded "generalized daemon-orphan detection" was memory-launcher (MCP) daemon handling: the reaper at `72bd1309978` carried `REAP_DAEMONS`, `_daemon_worktree_path_from_cmdline` and `_daemon_cmdline_is_orphan`, which reported (and with `--reap-daemons` killed) node daemons whose lease pointed at a deleted `.worktrees/` DB dir. Commit `3c7c3f83874` (2026-09-03, "remove the memory launcher, plugin, hooks and the tool-ownership commit gate") removed 117 lines from the reaper together with the memory launcher itself. `git log -S "fsmonitor"` over `.skilled/bin/` and `.opencode/bin/` returns no commit at all, so no reaper revision ever touched fsmonitor. [SOURCE: .skilled/bin/worktree-reaper.sh:1-261] [SOURCE: git show 72bd1309978:.opencode/bin/worktree-reaper.sh] [SOURCE: git log -S REAP_DAEMONS → 3c7c3f83874]

keyFindings.text: The repo already has three fsmonitor opt-out precedents, but they are not applied at the call sites that matter: `alignment-lib.cjs` runs git with `-c core.fsmonitor=false`, `continuity-freshness` (ts+js) defines `GIT_NO_FSMONITOR = ['-c','core.fsmonitor=false']`, and `git-context-extractor` uses a 5s `GIT_TIMEOUT_MS`. The unguarded index-reading call sites are: `generate-leaf-manifest.cjs:129` (check-ignore, no timeout), `regenerate-skill-derived.cjs:73` (check-ignore -q, no timeout), `verify-router-sync.cjs:168` (check-ignore, no timeout), `folder-detector.js:250` (status, no timeout), `collect-session-data.ts:1164` (status, 5s timeout but no fsmonitor opt-out), `git-standards.cjs:88` and `git-hook-gates.cjs:86,95` (rev-parse/config, no timeout), `write-containment.ts:431`, `score-fanout-pairs.cjs:743`, `heal-spec-docs.cjs:1264`, `behavior-bench-run.cjs:885`, `resolve-authority-root.ts:36`, and `resolve-cutover-binding.ts:99` — the last one runs on every append-gateway call. keyFindings.text: Yes — worktree creation still defaults to `.worktrees/` inside the checkout. `worktree-naming.sh` `_wn_base_dir` resolves env `SPECKIT_WORKTREE_BASE` > config `speckit.worktreeBase` > `.worktrees`, and the numbered allocator creates `.worktrees/{NNN}-{slug}` under that base; the launch wrapper and the reaper resolve the same precedence. All 12 registered task worktrees are back under `Public/.worktrees/` with `worktrees/NNN-slug` branches, so with the key unset every new worktree lands back inside the main checkout. ruledOutDirections.text: `git log -S "fsmonitor"` across `.skilled/bin/` and `.opencode/bin/` history returns nothing — no reaper revision ever handled fsmonitor; further history search on this path is exhausted.
Blaming the `.opencode` → `.skilled` source-root move (`330427cf308`) for the lost daemon handling: the removal predates it by two weeks and is a distinct commit.
Reverting `3c7c3f83874` to "restore" the reaper's daemon handling: the removed code targeted memory-launcher daemons that no longer exist; a revert would restore dead code, not fsmonitor coverage.
Searching for a committed `speckit.worktreeBase`: the key is local-only by design; `git log -S` hits are only the scripts that read/write it.
